entry.name: BattlefieldFlavor
entry.value: a twisted network of mud-soaked trenches, craters filled with Corpses and Bloody water,and ruined barbed wire entanglements. Amidst the Charnel house lie the remnants of conflict: scattered bodies, Undetonated munitions lurking in the muck, adding an ominous layer to the treacherous terrain blasted Clean of life by Conflict.
